item.title: Ukraine allies in Poland after Starlink sabotage, Trump diesel deal
item.description: Germany's Johann Wadephul said hybrid plots like the Starlink fire showed Europe was "in Russia's crosshairs." The UK's Ed Miliband said Trump's Russian diesel deal led to a "very difficult few days" diplomatically.
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: Ukraine and the US: What's next after Trump's diesel deal with Russia?
item.description: Donald Trump plans to allow the purchase of Russian diesel, drawing criticism at home and abroad. What is behind the US president’s decision and what should Ukraine do next? DW spoke with experts.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: Saudi Arabia's military struggle against Houthi attacks
item.description: Houthi attacks on airports and energy facilities are putting Saudi Arabia under pressure. Could a Saudi-led international military offensive succeed against the Iran-aligned Houthi militia in Yemen?
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: How will emergency rule in Pakistan's northwest affect Afghan ties?
item.description: Pakistan's decision to suspend Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's provincial government could further strain already tense relations between Islamabad and Kabul.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: DR Congo: Kabila’s move towards M23 raises questions over peace
item.description: Former DR Congo President Joseph Kabila has joined a new political-military front that brings together the Rwandan-backed AFC/M23 coalition. Analysts say it could reshape opposition to President Felix Tshisekedi.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: India: Can 'cockroaches' threaten Modi's political grip?
item.description: Thousands detained, leaders arrested on arrival, and a capital under lockdown: The youth-led protests against the election chief have the attention of the Indian government. But experts say toppling it is another matter.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: Critics warn of espionage risks as Slovakia restores military-diplomatic representation with Russia
item.description: Slovakia is restoring military-diplomatic relations with Russia for the first time since 2022. The government has defended the move but critics warn of espionage risks and further damage to trust within NATO.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: Germany's China calculation shifts as import pressures eclipse export benefits
item.description: Germany has long resisted tougher action against China, fearing retaliation. But rising pressure on key industries has pushed Berlin to seek stronger EU trade-defense powers to protect its industrial base.
item.dc:subject: Business

item.title: What is holding back Cyprus's Schengen ambitions?
item.description: The European Commission says Cyprus is ready to join the Schengen Area. Yet questions relating to the island's division and British military bases could still complicate its path to Europe's border-free travel zone.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: Starlink India launch: Why Elon Musk is still waiting
item.description: Despite securing key approvals, the Starlink satellite internet service remains in regulatory limbo, raising questions about security clearances, competition and India’s investment climate.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: UK: Iran 'highly likely' to be behind RAF Fairford incident
item.description: Prime Minister Andy Burnham told parliament there were "strong indications" of Iranian involvement. The government summoned Iran's ambassador. The scare at RAF Fairford led to the withdrawal of USAF B-1 heavy bombers.
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: Poland reports arrests of 2 Turkish citizens in Germany in connection with Starlink station fire last month
item.description: Polish authorities have reported the arrests of two Turkish citizens in Germany in connection with alleged sabotage of a Starlink station last month. Prime Minister Donald Tusk called the fire an act of "hybrid warfare."
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: Fact check: Viral videos falsely linked to Riyadh airport attacks
item.description: Many videos claiming to show an attack on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport have gone viral online. DW Fact check analyzes some of the most-shared footage and finds evidence it was created using AI.
item.dc:subject: World
